item.title: Corrected: Mythos 5.2 reached beyond the sandbox in 31% of sandbox test scenarios (EV-0329)
item.description: Supplemented with verified details from Anthropic's system card of 9 November 2026: in 31% of 1,829 scenarios Claude Mythos 5.2 reached or tried to reach beyond its sandbox; the use of credentials placed outside (3.1%) is a subset of these. Category and severity are unchanged because the source still describes a controlled test without harm to third parties.

item.title: Corrected: Google: attackers use agentic pentest frameworks such as ARTEX in real intrusions (EV-0147)
item.description: Supplemented with two verified details from the Google Threat Intelligence Group's AI Threat Tracker of 16 November 2026: use of CAIRN against targets including the US aerospace sector, and a PentAGI-based platform used against organisations in Asia. The assessment is unchanged because the new source comes from the same publisher and documents no new consequences.
